svg.title: Pappra keeps a task alive after the session ends
svg.desc: One agent session ends, the task does not: its goal, decisions and next step stay as plain files in the project, and any agent can resume them. An excerpt of real pappra resume output, framed as a hand-off from session A to session B, shows context complete, execution not allowed, and the next step to write the first test.

g.text: the task does not. Its goal, decisions
and next step stay in your project
as plain files any agent can resume.
